title: MURDLE — The Distracting Machine
subtitle: 3 suspects, 3 tools, 3 locations
storyHtml:
A test machine began flooding the Dynavics operations dashboard with nonsense alerts. While the team chased false leads, someone used the distraction to change a retail configuration.

Each consultant carried one tool to one workspace. Use the Business Central and LS Central evidence to identify the culprit, the tool, and the scene.

clues.text: An audit note confirmed that Adam Sellers had the LS Central handheld.
The AL development key was not in the LS Central Retail Lab.
Kieran Coles was not in the Business Central Sandbox.
Device telemetry traced the Business Central laptop to the LS Central Retail Lab.
The access log placed Kieran Coles in the LS Central Retail Lab.
